summary: Backend-only testing for Mythos Grid leaderboard API. Created pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py) with 17 tests covering health, validation, persistence, top-scores ordering, user stats, rank calculation, and global stats. ALL 17 TESTS PASSED (100% success rate). Data persistence verified via Create->GET pattern; rank is correctly computed based on user's MAX score; MongoDB ObjectId (_id) is properly excluded from responses.

minor.issue: datetime.utcnow() used indirectly is fine; leaderboard_routes.py correctly uses datetime.now(timezone.utc). However server.py line 34 still uses deprecated datetime.utcnow() for StatusCheck default_factory. Not tested (unused by game) but flagged for hygiene.
No upper bound on `limit` query param – a client could request a very large limit. Consider capping (e.g. max=200).
Score has no upper bound. A client can post arbitrarily huge integers (e.g. 10^18). Consider adding a sanity max_score cap.

Username lookup is case-sensitive and does not trim on read. If a client queries with surrounding whitespace it won't match stored records (stored value is trimmed on write). Minor UX/robustness concern.

action_items: (Optional) Replace deprecated datetime.utcnow() in /app/backend/server.py line 34 with datetime.now(timezone.utc).
(Optional) Enforce max cap on GET /api/leaderboard/top?limit= to prevent abuse.
(Optional) Consider trimming username on lookup in GET /api/leaderboard/user/{username} for consistency with POST behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: leaderboard_routes.py is clean, uses async/await, excludes _id via projection, validates input, and returns proper HTTP status codes.
Rank aggregation pipeline uses $group + $max + $sort correctly and matches the specified requirement (rank based on user's BEST score).
server.py correctly registers leaderboard_router under /api prefix and creates required MongoDB indexes on startup (username, score desc, timestamp desc).
seed_data_creation: Test data was created with TEST_<run_id>_ prefix and cleaned up in the final cleanup test via direct MongoDB delete_many. Production data unaffected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL is read from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env) = https://mythos-grid.preview.emergentagent.com. All leaderboard endpoints under /api/leaderboard/*. Test file uses TEST_<uuid>_ prefixed usernames and cleans up via direct Mongo at the end. Backend leaderboard implementation is stable and passing 100%.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All 12 requested test scenarios from the review request are covered and passing: health check, score submission, top scores, user stats, global stats, empty username 400, <2 char username 400, negative score 400, MongoDB persistence, high_score=MAX for multiple submissions, rank based on best score, non-existing user returns zero values.
